visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches into the frame and unties a golden ribbon on a cardboard Pizza Hut box. Behind the table, three individuals—a man in a blue sweatshirt, a man with curly hair in a green button-down shirt, and a woman in a brown shirt—look on with expectant smiles in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) The box lid is lifted, revealing a pizza with a unique ring-shaped crust in the center filled with a clear soup. The characters react with wide eyes and open-mouthed laughter, showing significant surprise. (3) The camera zooms in for an extreme close-up of the 'Beef Soup Pizza,' showing beef slices and white radish cubes submerged in the central soup ring, topped with green onions and peppers on the surrounding pizza sections. (4) The man in the green shirt uses a pizza wheel cutter to slice the crust near the soup ring while the man in blue watches intently. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the textures of the food. (5) The curly-haired man laughs heartily towards the camera while holding a slice of pizza. His facial expressions are highly animated, and the background displays a white wall with a bookshelf. (6) A montage shows the three people dipping the pizza into the central soup and taking large bites. The woman points at the pizza while chewing, exhibiting a positive reaction. (7) The group continues to laugh and converse while eating. The man in green claps his hands and gestures towards the pizza, concluding with a joyful and energetic atmosphere.
